property_summary: Invariant: after a successful fallback call at timestamp t (which stores pastBlockTime = t+1), any call at timestamp t+1 must revert because a strictly later timestamp is required — the mutant stores t, so the call at t+1 succeeds, violating the two-second minimum cooldown.
change_summary: Change the assignment to `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` instead of `block.timestamp + 1`.
